mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.address AS address, o.order_status AS orderStatus, COALESCE (SUM(oi.order_price * oi.quantity), 0) AS totalPrice, o.created_at AS createdAt FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_item AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.id, o.address, o.order_status, o.created_at ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
